The user approved the `/v9` homepage redesign ("thumbs up for v9"). Finish the "Website Overhaul v2" work: merge the approved `/v9` hero into the REAL live marketing homepage, then deploy Nxeon staging→prod. Work from /opt/nxeon on THIS host.

CONTEXT: A prior agent built `/v9` — a noindex draft route iterating on the homepage hero: new headline "Everything you build, online in 60 seconds" + product/audience subcopy + a friendly non-terminal `DeployStage` visual (a step animation resolving to a live-server card), keeping the old terminal lower down under "For the developers." The LIVE homepage was left unchanged. Now make the approved v9 hero the real homepage.

STEPS:
1. Find the `/v9` route files (likely `app/v9/` or a page under the marketing app) and the LIVE homepage (the marketing root — likely `app/(marketing)/page.tsx` or `app/page.tsx`; confirm which renders nxeon.cloud's home). Read both.
2. Bring the v9 hero into the live homepage: the new headline + subcopy + the `DeployStage` visual component, replacing the current hero, while keeping the rest of the homepage coherent (don't drop existing sections below the hero unless v9 intentionally revised them — match what v9 did). Reuse the v9 components rather than duplicating. Ensure it's NOT noindex (the live homepage must stay indexable) and remove any "draft"/checkpoint framing.
3. You may keep the `/v9` route as-is OR remove it (your call — if removing, delete the route cleanly). Don't break other routes.
4. Typecheck (`npx tsc --noEmit`) + `npm run build` — fix any errors. Verify the homepage renders.
5. Deploy: `git add` only the changed files (never `git add -A`; no scratch/secrets), commit (msg "Website Overhaul v2: ship the v9 hero to the live homepage", Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>) — post-commit hook auto-pushes to GitHub main. Then `bash scripts/deploy-staging.sh` (verify HTTP 200 on :8080), and if healthy, `bash scripts/promote-production.sh` (verify prod HTTP 200 + `nxeon-web` active). The user has authorized shipping this to prod.
6. Verify the LIVE homepage: `curl -s https://nxeon.cloud/ | grep -oiE '<title>[^<]*|Everything you build'` shows the new hero copy; site returns 200.
7. Board: on the "Nxeon" board, move the "Website Overhaul v2" card from Review to **Done** with a comment: the v9 hero is merged into the live homepage and shipped to production (nxeon.cloud), what changed, and whether you kept/removed the /v9 route.

CONSTRAINTS: only /opt/nxeon. Don't touch the .200/.215 boxes or other apps. Keep the live site working (if the build/promote fails, don't leave prod broken — report). If a classifier blocks a command, report verbatim + stop.

Return: the homepage + v9 files touched, what you merged, typecheck/build, staging + prod health, the live homepage verification, /v9 route disposition, and the card move.
